proofs.text: At the gate `signed`, commit a signature whose commit carries no signature of its own; build the payload and verify the signed cell reads `unsigned` with the reason `the signing commit is not signed`

rule_text: A signature the gate refuses leaves the signed cell at `unsigned` carrying the reason the check gave, one of `the signing commit is not signed`, `the signer is not on the list`, `the signer last touched the test` and `the signing commit is not on <branch>`

tests.body:
def test_an_unsigned_signing_commit_leaves_the_rule_unsigned(self):
        made = self._signed_project()
        try:
            made.signature('RULE-1')
            cell = made.cell('RULE-1', 'signed')
            assert cell['word'] == 'unsigned', cell
            assert cell['reasons'] == [
                'the signing commit is not signed'], cell
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_an_unsigned_signing_commit_leaves_the_rule_unsigned
